# rad-security_oci_register (Resource)

Register Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) tenancy with Rad Security



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the API signing key registered against the user.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded RSA private key matching the registered API signing key. Sent over TLS to Rad Security and stored in AWS Secrets Manager.
- `region` (String) OCI home region used to sign API calls (e.g. us-ashburn-1).
- `tenancy_ocid` (String) OCI Tenancy OCID — uniquely identifies the cloud account.
- `user_ocid` (String) OCID of the OCI user that Rad Security authenticates as.

### Read-Only

- `api_path` (String) Target of the API path
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rad_security_registered` (Boolean) Tracks if the account has been successfully registered.
